```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
```


## Load clean data

```{r}
data <- read.csv("~/GitHub/lapd-crime-analysis/crima_analysis/data/cleaned/lapd_cleaned.csv")
```

## Crime county by area
```{r}
glimpse(data)
```

```{r}
#Checking for missing
sum(is.na(data))
```

```{r}
#Crime distribution
data %>%
  count(Crm.Cd.Desc) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Crm.Cd.Desc, y = n, fill = Crm.Cd.Desc)) +
  geom_col()
```

```{r}
data %>%
  count(AREA.NAME, name = "total.crimes")
```
